summary: Nubo Express pre-launch integral audit (frontend only) - all 7 critical flows PASS: (1) admin login at /nubo-control loads dashboard with all sections (KPIs, Operaciones, Conductores, Regiones/Gestores, Contabilidad/Finanzas) no blank screens, no JS errors. (2) Route aliases /manager and /admin redirect to /nubo-control, /xyz123 catch-all redirects to /. (3) Customer login + 4 service tiles work: restaurant/supermarket/courier filter without logging out, ride tile navigates to /ride. (4) Nubo Ride client flow end-to-end: origin Algeciras -> dest Alhucemas -> Ver precios -> 3 vehicle cards with prices (Economy €219.67, Comfort €304.40, XL €405.98) -> select economy -> Pedir viaje -> ride-active-card shown with estado 'Buscando conductor…'. (5) Rider activation with NUBO-6NJP works, ride bead44d4 visible in rider-rides-section, Aceptar -> rider-active-ride shown, Iniciar -> Completar -> ride finished (active=0, toast 'Viaje completado'). (6) /track with ORD-4821 shows clean fallback 'Mapa en vivo próximamente' (NO Google InvalidKey error) and order data is displayed. (7) Session isolation verified: customer cookies do NOT grant access to /nubo-control (admin login shown).

issues: Google Maps InvalidKey console warning appears on admin dashboard map widget (expected per task note - placeholder API key); however the public /track page correctly shows a clean fallback. Consider also wrapping the admin 'Mapa de Flota en Tiempo Real' under MAPS_ENABLED to suppress the Google warning until the real key is configured.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin dashboard 'Mapa de Flota' still attempts to load Google Maps with placeholder key producing console warning 'InvalidKey'. The public /track already uses MAPS_ENABLED gate correctly - consider applying the same gate to the admin fleet map for consistency.
